name: Curilla
summary: A dedicated tank whose priorities are holding hate for the party
overview: Curilla is a tank designed to hold hate for the party.  By default, she has Warrior set as her support job and it cannot be changed.  Unlike retail, she posesses advanced AI to help her hold hate.

behaviors.title: Healing Priorities
behaviors.description: Curilla primarily focuses on healing herself to help gain enmity

behaviors.title: Combat Positioning
behaviors.description: Curilla is a front line tank and will run to the engaged enemy

behaviors.title: Support Job
behaviors.description: By default, Curilla has Warrior as her subjob which cannot be changed, therefore she is ineligible for the support job quest

equipment: Default Trust equipment — Future updates may allow players to customize the gear the Trust wears as a cosmetic change.
notes: Kupipi uses Cleopatra Custom AI v6.1

name: Kupipi
summary: A dedicated healer whose priorities and positioning adapt to her selected support job.
overview: Kupipi supports the party with healing, status recovery, and defensive magic. Unlike retail, she will not use the highest Cure for standard healing based on her level and is more MP effecient.  Her custom support job changes healing thresholds, spell options, and frontline positioning.

behaviors.title: Healing Priorities
behaviors.description: Kupipi monitors party members and prioritizes healing based on their current HP. Her selected support job determines when she begins healing and how she responds to emergencies.

behaviors.title: Combat Positioning
behaviors.description: Kupipi normally remains behind the frontline. When Warrior or Ninja is selected as her support job, she moves into melee range to join the fight.

behaviors.title: Support Job
behaviors.description:
By default, Kupipi has a White Mage as her subjob, but when a specific quest is completed, players can choose between three different subjobs.

Red Mage - Kupipi raises her healing threshold to be a more competent healer.

Warrior - Kupipi will move to the frontline to melee and her AI shifts to a more melee based strategy while healing becomes second nature.

Ninja - Kupipi gains access to Utsusemi and adopts a more aggressive frontline role.

equipment: Default Trust equipment — Future updates may allow players to customize the gear the Trust wears as a cosmetic change.
notes: Kupipi uses Cleopatra Custom AI v6.1
